# Esri World Imagery and Wayback

World Imagery provides one metre or better satellite and aerial imagery for most of the world's landmass and lower resolution satellite imagery worldwide. High-resolution imagery is typically within 3 to 5 years of currency. Sources include worldwide 15 m TerraColor imagery at small and medium scales, commercial basemap products at 15 cm to 1.2 m, and community-contributed aerial photography at 30 cm to 3 cm.

The World Imagery Wayback app gives access to earlier published versions of the World Imagery map, so the same place can be seen at different capture dates. The layer carries citations per location (provider, collection date, resolution, accuracy, source), visible with the Identify tool.

## Terms of use (as stated on the item page)

- Export: this layer is not intended to be used to export tiles for offline use; Esri points to the "World Imagery (for Export)" layer for that purpose.
- Acknowledgments: Esri, the imagery provider, Earthstar Geographics and the GIS User Community.

## How the project uses it
Wayback captures are shown to inspectors as dated context with attribution. They are not model inputs and not proof of finishing; generated HTML that embeds Esri pixels stays local for educational review.
